progression.narrative: The performance opens on F3 and dwells most on G in Daramad-e Sevom (Kereshme). The line peaks at Bb4 (458.8 Hz) at 0:49.5. It closes on C4, not the tonic (G3 → G3 → Ak3 → G3 → G3 → C4).
